name: Etsy
description: Run an Etsy shop from any AI agent: create draft listings, edit and publish them, add photos, videos and digital files, set price, stock, attributes and translations, add tracking to orders, and read listings, orders, receipts and reviews. OAuth2 with automatic refresh-token rotation + x-api-key dual auth.
instructions:
This connector uses the Etsy Open API v3 (developers.etsy.com). You authorize it once, in AnythingMCP; from then on the short-lived access token (1 hour) is renewed automatically, and the refresh token Etsy replaces on every renewal is stored for you.

**Setup**:
1. Register an app at https://www.etsy.com/developers/register (for your own shop: a personal app). Etsy lists it on https://www.etsy.com/developers/your-apps under **Personal Apps**, with the status *Pending Personal Approval*.
2. Copy the app's **Keystring** and **Shared Secret** from that list into `ETSY_CLIENT_ID` and `ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET`, leave `ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN` empty, and save. This works while the app is still pending.
3. Wait for Etsy's approval (Etsy emails you; most apps are approved within a day). Until then Etsy refuses the keys with a 403 and the app's page does not open.
4. Once the app is active, click its name to open its page and add this **callback URL**: `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. Etsy compares it character for character (https, upper/lower case, no trailing slash).
5. Open the connector and click **Authorize with Provider**. Sign in to Etsy, approve, and you land back on the connector page with the tools ready. AnythingMCP runs Etsy's OAuth2 PKCE flow (S256) for you.

**Scopes**: the connector asks for `email_r shops_r listings_r listings_w listings_d transactions_r transactions_w`: read your account, shops, listings and orders, edit listings, delete listings (the delete tool is installed switched off), and add tracking to orders. **Connectors authorized with an earlier scope list** (only the read scopes, or without `listings_d`) get the current list when you click **Authorize with Provider** again; until then Etsy answers "Access token lacks scope" to the tools that need the missing scope.

**Already have a refresh token?** You can paste it into `ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN` instead of step 5, if you obtained it yourself through Etsy's OAuth2 PKCE flow for the same app. Connectors set up that way keep working as they are; there is nothing to do. Clicking **Authorize with Provider** on one replaces its token with a new one, and needs the callback URL from step 4.

**Authentication**: the connector attaches both headers on every request:
  - `Authorization: Bearer <auto-refreshed access token>`
  - `x-api-key: ${ETSY_CLIENT_ID}:${ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET}`

Etsy requires the API key on **every** request, OAuth or not, and it must carry the
Keystring AND the Shared secret separated by a colon. The Keystring alone earns a
`403 {"error":"Invalid API key: should be in the format 'keystring:shared_secret'."}`
on every call.

The access token is kept in memory and written back, together with the rotated refresh token, into this connector's own encrypted configuration, so a restart does not lose it. Per Etsy's policy, **refresh tokens rotate on each use**; AnythingMCP stores the new one from every refresh response and re-uses it automatically.

**If a call says the access token could not be renewed**: an Etsy refresh token works once and expires after 90 days unused. Click **Authorize with Provider** on the connector page to get a new one.

**Shop ID**: every account has a shop_id. Get it from `etsy_get_authenticated_user` then `etsy_get_user_shops`.

**Reading the shop**: `etsy_get_listings_by_shop` lists your own listings in any state (active, draft, inactive, sold out); `etsy_get_shop_listings_active` is the public view any visitor sees; `etsy_list_shop_sections` and `etsy_get_listings_by_shop_section` go by shop section; `etsy_get_shop_reviews` lists the reviews. `etsy_list_taxonomy_properties` gives the properties (size, colour, material) a category allows.

**Orders and sales**: `etsy_get_shop_receipts` lists orders and `etsy_get_shop_receipt` reads one with its line items. `etsy_get_shop_transactions` lists the sold line items of the whole shop (listing, SKU, quantity, price, variations), the view for sales per product. `etsy_get_listings_by_ids` then reads up to 100 of the listings behind them in one call. `etsy_add_order_tracking` marks an order as shipped with its tracking code, and Etsy e-mails the buyer at once.

**Attributes, translations and media**: `etsy_get_listing_properties` reads a listing's attributes (colour, material, size) and `etsy_set_listing_property` sets one, with ids from `etsy_list_taxonomy_properties`. `etsy_read_listing_translation`, `etsy_add_listing_translation` (new language) and `etsy_replace_listing_translation` (existing one) handle titles, descriptions and tags in de, en, es, fr, it, ja, nl, pl and pt. `etsy_list_listing_images` lists the photos; `etsy_list_listing_variation_images` and `etsy_assign_variation_images` link photos to variation values (the assign call replaces every link). `etsy_list_listing_videos` and `etsy_add_listing_video` handle the listing video (one per listing, 5 to 15 seconds); `etsy_list_listing_files` and `etsy_upload_listing_file` the files buyers download from a digital listing. Uploads take a public URL that AnythingMCP downloads, up to the server's upload limit (10 MB by default). `etsy_list_production_partners` gives the ids for production_partner_ids.

**Beyond your shop**: `etsy_search_active_listings` searches every active listing on Etsy (keywords, category, price range) and `etsy_search_shops` finds shops by name.

**Switched off at install**: `etsy_delete_listing_permanently` (deletes a listing for good; to hide one, set state=inactive with `etsy_edit_listing`), `etsy_delete_listing_image` and `etsy_delete_listing_property`. Turn them on under the connector's tools when you need them.

**Pagination**: `?limit=N&offset=M` (limit max 100).

**Rate limits**: 10k req/24h per app. On 429 back off.

**Creating a listing** takes a few steps, in this order: find the category with `etsy_list_seller_taxonomy`; for a physical item get a shipping profile (`etsy_list_shipping_profiles`), a processing profile (`etsy_list_processing_profiles`) and, outside the EU, a return policy (`etsy_list_return_policies`); create the draft with `etsy_create_listing_draft`; add at least one photo with `etsy_add_listing_image`; publish with `etsy_edit_listing` and `state=active`. Change price or stock with `etsy_read_listing_inventory` then `etsy_set_listing_inventory`, which replaces the whole inventory. Etsy rejects titles with more than three words in capitals and tags longer than 20 characters; a shop on vacation cannot change listings.

**Out of scope here**: shop settings and shop sections (they need the `shops_w` scope), payment account, billing, taxonomy edits.
previousOAuthScopes: email_r shops_r listings_r listings_w transactions_r transactions_w

ETSY_CLIENT_ID.label: Keystring
ETSY_CLIENT_ID.help: Etsy's apps page, under Personal Apps: the Keystring of your app. Shown while the app is still pending.
ETSY_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: The Keystring is 24 lowercase letters and digits, nothing else (no spaces, no colon).

ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Shared Secret
ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same row, under Shared Secret. Paste it on its own: not the Keystring, not "keystring:secret".
ETSY_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Shared Secret alone: lowercase letters and digits, without the Keystring and without a colon.

ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh token
ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN.help: Leave empty: the authorization with Etsy fills it in.

prerequisites: An Etsy app of your own ([create one on Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/developers/register)). Etsy reviews every new app before it can be used, usually within a day: until then its Status says *Pending Personal Approval*, and its page, where the callback URL goes, does not open yet. You can enter the app's **Keystring** and **Shared Secret** while you wait: they are saved, and AnythingMCP tells you when Etsy accepts them. Once the app is active, add the callback URL `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` (or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself) on the app's page, character for character: without it Etsy refuses the sign-in.

verifyHints.403: Etsy does not accept these app keys yet. A new Etsy app stays Pending Personal Approval until Etsy approves it (Etsy emails you, usually within a day), and signing in only works after that. If your app already says Active, copy the Shared Secret again from the same row as this Keystring.

examples: Draft a listing for a hand-thrown mug: 28 EUR, 5 in stock, with my usual shipping profile
Add this tracking number to my last order
Show the reviews I got this month
needs: Your Etsy seller account, the one that owns the shop
About 10 minutes, plus Etsy's review of your new app: usually within a day
You can stop at any point: your keys are saved, and this page reopens where you left off.
setupGuide.why:
Etsy lets other tools reach a shop only through an app registered in the shop owner's account. Creating one is free: you fill in a short form at Etsy, and AnythingMCP uses the app's two keys to ask Etsy for access to your shop. Etsy reviews every new app before it can be used, which is why the setup has a short wait in the middle.

You approve that access on Etsy's own page. AnythingMCP never sees your Etsy password, and deleting the connector removes the keys and the access it holds.

steps.title: Create your Etsy app
steps.body:
Etsy opens its **Create a New App** form. Sign in with the account that owns your shop if Etsy asks, fill in the form as below, then click **Read Terms and Create App**.

Etsy then lists your app under **Personal Apps** with the status *Pending Personal Approval*. That is normal: you can go on right away.

values.label: Name
values.note: Any name works. Etsy shows it when you approve access.

values.label: Describe your application
values.value: Connects my own Etsy shop to my AI assistant through AnythingMCP, so I can manage my listings and orders from a chat. Only I use it.

values.label: Is your application commercial
values.note: You do not charge anyone for this app.

values.label: Features
values.value: Upload or edit listings, Read sales data

problems.q: Etsy shows a sign-in page instead of the form
problems.a: Sign in with the Etsy account that owns your shop, then click **Open Etsy's app form** again.

problems.q: Does it matter what I write in the description?
problems.a: Etsy reads it when it reviews the app. Describe what you will really do with it; the text above fits a shop owner connecting their own shop.

problems.q: Etsy says I already have an app in review
problems.a: You created one before: use that one. It is listed under **Personal Apps** on [Etsy's apps page](https://www.etsy.com/developers/your-apps). Tick the box and continue.

steps.title: Copy your two keys
steps.body:
On Etsy's apps page your app is listed under **Personal Apps**. Copy its **Keystring** and its **Shared Secret** into the fields below. This works while the app is still pending.

AnythingMCP saves them and asks Etsy whether your app is active yet.

problems.a: In the same row as the Keystring, under **Shared Secret**. Paste it on its own: not the Keystring, and not `keystring:secret`.

problems.q: I have more than one app on Etsy
problems.a: Use the app you created for AnythingMCP. The Keystring and the Shared Secret must come from the same row.

steps.title: Wait for Etsy's approval
steps.body:
Etsy reviews every new app before it can be used. Until then the **Status** of your app says **Pending Personal Approval**, and clicking its name does nothing.

Most apps are approved within a day, some take a few days. Etsy emails you when yours is approved. There is nothing else to do in the meantime.

problems.q: Clicking my app's name does nothing
problems.a: That is normal while the app is pending. Etsy opens the app's page only after the approval; you add the callback URL there in the next step.

problems.q: The Status says Active, but this page still waits
problems.a: Then Etsy refused the Shared Secret: it must belong to the Keystring in the same row. Go back one step and copy both keys again.
Etsy's email gives the reason. Create a new app (step 1) with the description shown there, which tells Etsy the app is only for your own shop, then copy the new app's keys in step 2.

problems.q: It has been more than a week
problems.a: Etsy reviews apps on its own schedule, and nobody outside Etsy can speed it up. Check that your app is still listed under **Personal Apps**, and if Etsy has not emailed you, ask Etsy's developer support about it.

steps.title: Add the callback URL
steps.body:
Your app is active. On Etsy's apps page, click your app's name under **Personal Apps** to open its page, add this address under **Callback URLs**, then save.

Paste it exactly as shown: Etsy compares it character for character, and without it Etsy refuses the sign-in.
steps.confirm: I added the callback URL and saved

problems.a: Click the name of your app under **Personal Apps** to open its page: the callback URLs are there. If clicking the name does nothing, the app is not approved yet; go back one step.

problems.q: Later Etsy says the redirect URI does not match
problems.a: The address at Etsy differs from the one above: often a space, a missing **s** in https, or a slash at the end. Copy it again with the button and replace the one at Etsy.

steps.title: Sign in with Etsy
steps.body: Sign in with the Etsy account that owns the shop you want to connect. AnythingMCP checks your keys once more before it opens Etsy.

problems.q: Etsy shows an error about the redirect URI
problems.a: The callback URL at Etsy differs from the one in the step before. Go back, copy it again with the button and replace the one at Etsy.

problems.q: I have more than one Etsy shop
problems.a: Sign in with the account that owns the shop you want to connect. For another shop, set up a second Etsy connector.

authConfig.scopes: email_r shops_r listings_r listings_w listings_d transactions_r transactions_w

tools.name: etsy_get_authenticated_user
tools.description: Return the user the OAuth token belongs to. Returns user_id, login_name, primary_email.

tools.name: etsy_get_user_shops
tools.description: List shops owned by a user. Returns shop_id, shop_name, currency_code, languages, login_name, last_updated_tsz, listing_active_count. For the connected account, take user_id from etsy_get_authenticated_user first.

user_id.description: Etsy user ID (a positive number): use the user_id returned by etsy_get_authenticated_user.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop
tools.description: Fetch one shop by shop_id with full details (announcement, sale message, etc.).

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_listings_active
tools.description: Public list of a shop's active listings, as any visitor sees them. Etsy caps how far this public view can page (large offsets are refused); to go through all of your own shop's listings, or drafts and inactive ones, use etsy_get_listings_by_shop.

offset.description: Pagination offset (0 = first page). Keep it small: Etsy refuses large offsets on this public endpoint.

sort_order.description: asc, ascending, desc, descending, up, down.

tools.name: etsy_get_listings_by_shop
tools.description: Listings of your own shop by state (active, inactive, sold_out, draft, removed, expired), as the shop owner sees them. Authenticated, so it pages through the whole catalogue, and it can include Inventory and Shipping. Use it rather than etsy_get_shop_listings_active for your own shop.

includes.description: Optional extra data, comma-separated, any of: Shipping, Images, Shop, User, Translations, Inventory, Videos, Personalization, BuyerPrice.

tools.name: etsy_get_listing
tools.description: Fetch one listing by listing_id with full details: title, description, state, price, quantity, tags, URL and the optional includes.

includes.description: Optional extra data, comma-separated, any of: Images, Shop, User, Translations, Videos, Personalization, BuyerPrice. Etsy answers 400 to anything else, Inventory included: for SKUs, quantities and prices per variation call etsy_read_listing_inventory. Shipping comes with the shop's shipping profiles, not with the listing.

tools.name: etsy_get_listings_by_ids
tools.description: Fetch up to 100 listings in one call by their listing ids, with the same details as etsy_get_listing (title, description, state, price, quantity, tags, URL). Use it to look up the listings behind a page of orders or transactions instead of one call per listing.

listing_ids.description: Comma-separated listing ids, at most 100, e.g. "1234567890,1234567891" (listing_id from etsy_get_shop_transactions, etsy_get_shop_receipts or the listing tools).

includes.description: Optional extra data, comma-separated, any of: Images, Shop, User, Translations, Videos, Personalization, BuyerPrice. Etsy answers 400 to anything else, Inventory included: for SKUs, quantities and prices per variation call etsy_read_listing_inventory. Shipping comes with the shop's shipping profiles, not with the listing.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD) to convert the listing prices to.

buyer_country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the buyer (e.g. DE, GB), for buyer-facing prices with VAT and included shipping. It does not filter the listings.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_receipts
tools.description: List the shop's orders (receipts) with buyer, totals, payment and shipping status, filtered by creation or change date and by paid or shipped state. Pages with limit and offset.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_receipt
tools.description: Fetch one receipt with buyer info, transactions[], shipping address.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_transactions
tools.description: List the shop's sold items (transactions, one per listing line of an order): transaction_id, receipt_id, listing_id, title, sku, quantity, price, shipping cost, variations, buyer user id and the paid, shipped and expected ship dates. Use it for sales per product or SKU; etsy_get_shop_receipts is the order-level view. Pages with limit and offset.

tools.name: etsy_get_shop_reviews
tools.description: List the shop's reviews (transactions with feedback): rating, review text, listing id and date, optionally since min_created. Pages with limit and offset. Etsy treats this endpoint as public and refuses large offsets: to reach older reviews, narrow with min_created instead of paging far.

offset.description: Pagination offset (0 = first page). Keep it small: Etsy refuses large offsets on this public endpoint.

tools.name: etsy_get_listings_by_shop_section
tools.description: List the shop's listings filed under one or more of its sections (section ids from etsy_list_shop_sections). Etsy treats this endpoint as public and refuses large offsets; to go through all of your own shop's listings, use etsy_get_listings_by_shop.

offset.description: Pagination offset (0 = first page). Keep it small: Etsy refuses large offsets on this public endpoint.

tools.name: etsy_list_seller_taxonomy
tools.description: The full tree of Etsy seller categories (id, name, children). Use it to find the taxonomy_id for a new listing. The response is large: look for the closest leaf category and keep only its id.

tools.name: etsy_list_taxonomy_properties
tools.description: Properties (size, colour, material…) and their allowed values for one seller category. Needed when an inventory product sets property_values.

tools.name: etsy_list_shipping_profiles
tools.description: The shop's shipping profiles. A physical listing needs one: pass its shipping_profile_id when creating the listing.

tools.name: etsy_list_processing_profiles
tools.description: The shop's processing profiles (Etsy calls them readiness states: ready to ship or made to order, with processing times). A physical listing needs one: pass its readiness_state_id.

tools.name: etsy_list_return_policies
tools.description: The shop's return policies. Publishing a physical listing needs a return_policy_id (not for EU-based shops).

tools.name: etsy_list_shop_sections
tools.description: The shop's sections, to file a listing under one with shop_section_id.

tools.name: etsy_read_listing_inventory
tools.description: Products, prices, quantities and SKUs of a listing, per variation. Read this before etsy_set_listing_inventory: that call replaces the whole inventory.

tools.name: etsy_create_listing_draft
tools.description: Create a listing as a draft (not visible to buyers). A physical listing also needs shipping_profile_id and readiness_state_id; get them, and taxonomy_id, from the etsy_list_* tools first. Add photos with etsy_add_listing_image, then publish with etsy_edit_listing state=active.

price.description: Price in the shop currency, e.g. 24.5.

title.description: Listing title, at most 140 characters. Letters, numbers, punctuation and spaces only; "&" at most once; no more than 3 words starting with two capital letters.

who_made.description: Who made the item. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

when_made.description: When it was made. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

is_supply.description: true for a craft supply, false for a finished product. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile ID (etsy_list_shipping_profiles). Required for physical listings.

readiness_state_id.description: Processing profile ID (etsy_list_processing_profiles). Required for physical listings.

return_policy_id.description: Return policy ID (etsy_list_return_policies). Required to publish a physical listing, except for EU-based shops.

tags.description: Up to 13 tags, comma-separated: letters, numbers, spaces, - and ' only. On English listings each tag has at most 20 characters (Etsy refuses longer ones); listings in other languages may have longer tags.

materials.description: Materials, comma-separated. Letters, numbers and spaces only.

should_auto_renew.description: Renew automatically for four months when the listing expires.

is_taxable.description: Apply the shop's tax rates at checkout.

tools.name: etsy_edit_listing
tools.description: Change a listing: title, description, tags, category, shipping, section, or state. state=active publishes a draft (it needs at least one image) and state=inactive takes a listing off the shop. Send only the fields to change, but who_made, when_made and is_supply always together. Price and quantity are not here: use etsy_set_listing_inventory.

state.description: active publishes the listing (draft or inactive); inactive hides it.

title.description: Listing title, at most 140 characters. Letters, numbers, punctuation and spaces only; "&" at most once; no more than 3 words starting with two capital letters.

who_made.description: Who made the item. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

when_made.description: When it was made. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

is_supply.description: true for a craft supply, false for a finished product. Etsy needs who_made, when_made and is_supply together.

shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile ID (etsy_list_shipping_profiles). Required for physical listings.

return_policy_id.description: Return policy ID (etsy_list_return_policies). Required to publish a physical listing, except for EU-based shops.

tags.description: Up to 13 tags, comma-separated: letters, numbers, spaces, - and ' only. On English listings each tag has at most 20 characters (Etsy refuses longer ones); listings in other languages may have longer tags.

materials.description: Materials, comma-separated. Letters, numbers and spaces only.

should_auto_renew.description: Renew automatically for four months when the listing expires.

is_taxable.description: Apply the shop's tax rates at checkout.

tools.name: etsy_set_listing_inventory
tools.description: Set price, quantity and SKU of a listing, per variation. It REPLACES the whole inventory: read it with etsy_read_listing_inventory, change what you need, and send every product back. In each product keep sku and property_values exactly as read: every property value needs property_id, property_name, scale_id (when the read has one), value_ids and values (Etsy refuses a value without property_name); in each offering send price as a plain number (amount / divisor from the read, e.g. 2450/100 = 24.5), quantity, is_enabled and readiness_state_id. Etsy refuses an offering without readiness_state_id ("All offerings need readiness state"): keep the one from the read, or take an id from etsy_list_processing_profiles. Unless quantity_on_property lists the property that varies, every product must have the same quantity ("quantity must be consistent across all products"); the same holds for price with price_on_property. Leave out product_id, offering_id, is_deleted and scale_name.

products.description: Every product of the listing, e.g. [{"sku": "MUG-01", "property_values": [], "offerings": [{"price": 24.5, "quantity": 10, "is_enabled": true, "readiness_state_id": 1234567}]}].

price_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the price (as returned by the read).

quantity_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the quantity.

sku_on_property.description: Property IDs whose values change the SKU.

tools.name: etsy_add_listing_image
tools.description: Add a photo to a listing from a public image URL (JPG, PNG or GIF, up to 10 MB). rank 1 is the main photo. Etsy allows up to 20 images per listing.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image. AnythingMCP downloads it and uploads it to Etsy.

overwrite.description: Replace the image already at this rank.

tools.name: etsy_add_order_tracking
tools.description: Mark an order (receipt) as shipped with its tracking code. Etsy emails the buyer the shipping notification.

carrier_name.description: Carrier, e.g. dhl, ups, usps, royal-mail, deutsche-post.

note_to_buyer.description: Optional message in the buyer's notification.

send_bcc.description: Also send the notification to the seller.

tools.name: etsy_get_listing_properties
tools.description: Read the attribute values set on a listing (colour, material, size, occasion, ...): one entry per property with property_id, property_name, scale_id, value_ids and values. The properties a category allows come from etsy_list_taxonomy_properties; change one with etsy_set_listing_property.

tools.name: etsy_set_listing_property
tools.description: Set one attribute of a listing (e.g. primary colour, material, occasion), replacing its current values. property_id, the allowed value_ids and, for sized properties, scale_id come from etsy_list_taxonomy_properties for the listing's taxonomy_id; values holds the matching display names in the same order. Returns the property as stored.

property_id.description: Property ID, e.g. 200 for primary colour (from etsy_list_taxonomy_properties).

value_ids.description: IDs of the chosen values, e.g. [1213].

values.description: Display names of the chosen values, same order as value_ids, e.g. ["Beige"].

scale_id.description: Measurement scale, for properties such as sizes that have one.

tools.name: etsy_delete_listing_property
tools.description: Remove one attribute (property) and its values from a listing. The listing stays; Etsy may then flag it as missing a required attribute for its category.

tools.name: etsy_read_listing_translation
tools.description: Read a listing's translation into one language: translated title, description and tags. Etsy answers 404 when the listing has no translation in that language yet; add one with etsy_add_listing_translation.

tools.name: etsy_add_listing_translation
tools.description: Add a translation of a listing for buyers browsing Etsy in another language: title, description and optional tags in that language. Use it when the language has no translation yet (otherwise Etsy answers 409); change an existing one with etsy_replace_listing_translation.

title.description: Translated title, at most 140 characters, same title rules as the listing.

tags.description: Up to 13 translated tags, comma-separated. In English each tag has at most 20 characters; other languages may have longer tags.

tools.name: etsy_replace_listing_translation
tools.description: Replace a listing's existing translation into one language: send the full translated title and description (and tags, which are cleared when left out). For a language without a translation use etsy_add_listing_translation.

tags.description: Up to 13 translated tags, comma-separated. In English each tag has at most 20 characters; other languages may have longer tags.

tools.name: etsy_list_listing_images
tools.description: List the photos of a listing in display order: listing_image_id, rank, url_fullxfull and smaller sizes, dimensions, alt_text and the dominant colour. Use the ids with etsy_assign_variation_images or etsy_delete_listing_image.

tools.name: etsy_delete_listing_image
tools.description: Remove a photo from a listing. An active listing must keep at least one photo. Cannot be undone: to bring the photo back, upload it again with etsy_add_listing_image.

tools.name: etsy_list_listing_variation_images
tools.description: List which photo is shown for which variation value of a listing (e.g. the red mug photo for Colour = Red): entries with property_id, value_id, value and image_id.

tools.name: etsy_assign_variation_images
tools.description: Link listing photos to variation values, so buyers see the right photo when they pick an option. Replaces all existing links: send every pair you want to keep. property_id and value_id come from the listing's inventory (etsy_read_listing_inventory), image_id from etsy_list_listing_images; only one property per listing can have variation images.

tools.name: etsy_list_listing_files
tools.description: List the downloadable files of a digital listing: listing_file_id, filename, filesize, filetype, rank and creation time. Physical listings have none.

tools.name: etsy_upload_listing_file
tools.description: Attach a file buyers download after purchase to a digital listing (type download or both), from a public URL. Etsy allows up to 5 files per listing; the connector downloads the URL and uploads it, up to the server's file upload limit (10 MB by default).

listing_id.description: Listing ID of a digital listing.

file_url.description: Public https URL of the file (PDF, ZIP, image, ...).

name.description: File name buyers see, with extension, e.g. pattern.pdf.

rank.description: Position among the listing's files, 1 first.

tools.name: etsy_list_listing_videos
tools.description: List the videos of a listing: video_id, height, width, thumbnail_url, video_url and video_state (active or still processing). A listing has at most one video.

tools.name: etsy_add_listing_video
tools.description: Upload an existing video file to a listing from a public URL. Etsy takes one video per listing, 5 to 15 seconds long, and processes it after upload (video_state stays inactive for a while). The connector downloads the URL and uploads it, up to the server's file upload limit (10 MB by default).

video_url.description: Public https URL of the video file (MP4, MOV, ...).

name.description: File name of the video, with extension, e.g. mug.mp4.

tools.name: etsy_delete_listing_permanently
tools.description: Delete a listing for good, in any state (active, inactive, draft, expired, sold out). Its photos, inventory, translations and stats are gone and it cannot be restored; to hide a listing for now use etsy_edit_listing with state=inactive instead. Needs the listings_d scope.

tools.name: etsy_search_active_listings
tools.description: Search all active listings on Etsy, not only your shop's, by keywords, category, price range or shop location: e.g. to see what similar items cost. Returns listings with listing_id, title, price, shop_id, url, tags and quantity, and count for paging. sort_on and sort_order only work together with keywords.

keywords.description: Search words, e.g. ceramic mug handmade.

shop_location.description: Shop location, e.g. Germany or Berlin.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to convert prices into, e.g. EUR.

buyer_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; only listings that ship there.

tools.name: etsy_search_shops
tools.description: Find Etsy shops by name. Returns matching shops with shop_id, shop_name, title, url, listing_active_count and review summary, and count for paging.

shop_name.description: Shop name or part of it.

tools.name: etsy_list_production_partners
tools.description: List the shop's production partners (people or companies who help make the items): production_partner_id, partner_name and location. Listings made with help name them in production_partner_ids when created or edited.
